batches.title: Objetos básicos: piloto (6)
batches.style: Style: original painterly dark-fantasy still life, rich oil-paint brushwork, a single subject centred with generous margin on a very dark warm umber background (#140F0B) that fades to near-black at every edge, soft warm amber rim light from the upper left, restrained palette of oak brown, iron grey, cream, muted red, ochre and moss. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no border, no people, no faces, no hands.
batches.notes: First real run of the image queue (RYT-169). Same style as the nine item category plates of RYT-112.

requests.title: Objeto básico: Potion of Healing
requests.purpose: Picture of the basic item "Potion of Healing" (key potionOfHealing) in inventory, storeroom and shop tiles of 40px or more, instead of its category painting.
requests.prompt: Create a square (1:1) image. Item icon: a small round glass flask of glowing ruby-red liquid, stoppered with cork and tied with twine. Bold simple silhouette that reads clearly at thumbnail size.
acceptance: Shows only a small round glass flask of glowing ruby-red liquid, recognisable at 40px.
Same look as the category plates in public/art/items: one centred subject, dark umber ground fading to near-black, warm amber rim light from the upper left.
No text, letters, runes, frame, border, hands or people.
